headline: Study measures MCP tool-poisoning exposure across 12 agent frameworks
summary: A new arXiv paper reports a controlled measurement of malicious MCP tool-description attacks across 12 agent frameworks, 18 models and 45 scenarios. The authors report vulnerable behavior in 22.9% of 9,720 tested framework-model-scenario cells and classify 12.1% of vulnerable cells as actual secret exfiltration. The tested threat model requires a malicious MCP server to be registered already. These are author-reported lab outcomes; the study covers a limited framework set and July 2026 model versions, and does not establish deployment prevalence or independent replication. The linked tool repository README also states that its Distribution License restricts use to authorized security testing, defensive validation and academic research, and prohibits redistribution and modification; the full license and result artifacts were not reviewed.
